canonical.title: Rank Transform of an Array
canonical.sourceFilePath: 09. Heaps/2. Medium Problems/05. Arrange by rank.cpp

narrative.title: The Freight Weight Percentile Stamp
narrative.scenario: A freight yard stamps each incoming crate with a density rank: the lightest crate in the batch gets rank 1, the next distinct weight rank 2, and so on — crates sharing a weight share a rank. The stamping station processes the batch in weight order and writes each rank back onto the crate's original position on the conveyor.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array arr of crate weights.
narrative.outputFormat: Return an array where entry i is the rank of arr[i]: its 1-based position among the sorted distinct values.

testCases.explanation: Distinct weights in order are 10, 20, 40 — the two 20s share rank 2.
One distinct weight means every crate is rank 1.
